name: Mary
overview: Mary is a female figure identified as possibly the wife of Clopas according to John 19:25. No tribal affiliation or additional notes are provided, focusing her identity primarily on this relationship. Her role is presented within the context of the New Testament narrative.
namesAndTitles: The name Mary, as recorded in John 19:25, carries multiple possible meanings including bitterness, plump one, wished-for child, or one who loves or is loved. This variety reflects the commonality and significance of the name in the biblical context without a direct divine bestowal noted.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture infers Mary as the wife of Clopas in John 19:25, establishing a familial connection. Beyond this inferred relationship, no further family details are recorded in the provided information.
scriptureSignificance: Mary's mention as the wife of Clopas situates her within the circle of individuals present at significant moments in Jesus' life, particularly His crucifixion as noted in John 19:25. While not the virgin Mary, her presence reflects the broader community surrounding Christ and contributes to the biblical witness of Jesus' final hours. Her role, though less prominently detailed, is part of the fulfillment of God’s redemptive plan through faithful followers.
